releaseNotes: v1.18.2: major call reliability release, tested live on real devices. Calls to sleeping/locked phones now ring reliably; no more false busy; crash fixes for call cancel and video; ghost calls and stale call notifications eliminated; answering is instant and clean. (Updating from the OLD Dunes app? This installs as a NEW app: open it, release your @username from the old app's Settings first if you have one, re-add your contacts, then uninstall the old Dunes.)
